connector.name: CyberLens
connector.registryDescription: Security scanning for websites, public repositories, and Open CLAW skills.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cyberlens-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shadoprizm account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CYBERLENS_API_KEY
env.description: CyberLens API key. Optional if you use the connect_account browser flow.

env.name: CYBERLENS_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional override for the CyberLens public scan API base URL.
